statement: Partition-key ordering preserves all A1-v7 routing and split/merge hardening while closing the post-attempt consumer gaps: KeyRangeManager ID-only partition lists remain valid for split evaluation without entering row-based fallback adjacency; coalesced evaluation context is a bounded stable union that never erases existing diagnostics and always preserves reactive write_activity; numeric-TEXT detection uses a RegExp exec intrinsic captured at module load; split routing rejects Proxy metadata and Proxy target-ID arrays before descriptor traps can run; and all v7/v6 SQLite-BINARY, numeric/TEXT, typed refusal, own-data, prototype-pollution, captured-intrinsic, table-ID and row-field semantics remain unchanged.

constraints.statement: Supersedes sealed partition-key-ordering-owner-completion-v7 after the newer structured Copilot review on PR #92 (2026-10-03T07:01:21Z) rejected exact post-attempt head f45fdd68072ff6575647ad67123fc0ff5e7cbcbb for four defects. The earlier 06:55 ACCEPT is older and non-governing. Preserve v7 predicate/evidence unchanged.

When loadEvaluationPartitions falls back to KeyRangeManager.getAllPartitions(), primitive string partition IDs remain valid split-evaluation inputs. They are never fed into row canonicalization or row-based fallback adjacency; merge adjacency continues to use KeyRangeManager.getSortedPartitions().

Coalesced reasonCodes and partitionIds remain bounded by the canonical evaluation-context limit. Overflow truncates later diagnostic values rather than erasing the accumulated context; existing pending values remain stable. If write_activity appears in either valid input it survives the bounded merge so reactive pressure bypass cannot be silently disabled.

Numeric-TEXT recognition invokes a RegExp.prototype.exec intrinsic captured at module initialization. Replacing either RegExp.prototype.exec or test after load cannot change compareRoutingKeys semantics.

Proxy metadata objects and Proxy targetPartitionIds arrays are rejected before any getOwnPropertyDescriptor/get/iterator trap is invoked. Normal own-data metadata and ordinary dense target arrays retain existing routing semantics.

Preserve all independently proven v7 behavior: invalid table-ID validation before absence, bounded iterator-free evaluation rows, own-data partition row fields, captured array/sort/Reflect/Object intrinsics, safe nested context canonicalization, execution-options protection, canonical routing -1/0/1 results, invalid-versus-absent refusal, SQLite BINARY UTF-8 including non-BMP, numeric/TEXT compatibility, and KeyRange/PartitionResolver/QueryGroup ownership.

Each new v8 witness is run against exact rejected post-attempt v7 candidate f45fdd68072ff6575647ad67123fc0ff5e7cbcbb and must fail for the named production mechanism. Harness-only failures do not satisfy the control.
Persisted key type metadata, exact large-integer boundary representation, parser/bind precision, encoding migration and old-boundary revalidation remain A2.
Any v8 source candidate requires a category-complete independent verification newer than its last attempt, covering both sealed verificationTemplates and exact candidate fingerprints.
No Raft runtime, consensus transport, lifecycle, membership or formation behavior changes.
